source.dependency: Already pinned windows0.62.2 associated only with cueglint-local target-Windows features; no package/version addition.

source_checks.assessment: Accepts only float32 and signed PCM16/24/32, bounded1–32channels and8–192kHz. Precision, alignment and byte rate are checked. Alignment equality short-circuits before rate multiplication, which remains bounded.

Native capacity must be positive and at most2seconds; packet frame count must be positive and fit that capacity. Checked byte count precedes slice construction. Native-pointer validity still depends on the documented COM allocation/buffer contracts.
SILENT is handled before null/pointer-to-slice conversion, so a silent buffer never reads the pointer. Nonsilent null data is rejected. Timestamp/error/unknown-flag checks occur before sample reads.

Each owned packet preserves SystemAudio source/native rate and exact block length/timestamp offset. PCM sign extension/scaling and float finite checks are consistent with the selected format. Downmix uses f64 accumulation; only validated finite packet samples reach the shared queue.

Writes split into at most1024-frame packets, check stop/mute before each block, use nonblocking sends and increment sequence even for queue-full drops. Full queue increments dropped metrics; disconnected receiver fails visibly. Checked sequence/time arithmetic rejects overflow.

QPC calibration uses the shared capture origin, a bounded bracket and integer conversion from documented100ns timestamps. Rejects uncertain timestamps, later discontinuity/device-position gaps, backward/non-increasing time, future time beyond1ms and overflow. First discontinuity is separately allowed; no replacement clock is guessed.

One owned worker contains every native audio interface. A bounded1-slot startup acknowledgement transfers success only. Initialization errors close the acknowledgement and are joined/reported. Stop sets the gate, unparks and consumes/joins the handle once; Drop is a fallback, not detachment.

Apartment cleanup is declared before COM interfaces and therefore drops last. Mix-format task allocation has CoTaskMemFree ownership. Buffer/started-client guards release/stop on unwind; ordinary Result paths combine processing/release/stop errors without replacing the primary error.

Null mix pointer rejects; unaligned schema reads and declared extensible-size check avoid Rust alignment assumptions. Subformat/channel mask/valid-bit checks fail closed. These checks rely on Windows supplying the allocation it declares; source inspection cannot validate a corrupt driver pointer.

Worker initializes its own STA, selects only default eRender/eConsole endpoint, uses shared LOOPBACK mode, queries native mix/capacity and retains that route. GetBuffer data is consumed before ReleaseBuffer on the same thread; zero-frame empty results do not create a data slice. No event callback, new UI selector, subprocess or model work is introduced.

New native implementation is Windows-only; portable helpers/tests compile on test builds elsewhere. Capture.start routes Windows system audio explicitly and errors instead of substituting microphone. Windows stop goes through the existing both-source helper after both owners are taken and the common mute gate closes.

Only Windows bypasses the screen-permission prerequisite for system audio. Microphone permission and actual screen capture/OCR boundaries remain unchanged. Capture and native I/O remain outside UI drawing/audio callbacks.

Native COM/driver calls, startup acknowledgement and owned join have no hard timeout or interruption guarantee. Stop can wait for an in-flight OS call; no thread is detached to manufacture completion.
Panic cleanup is best effort; normal Result-path release/stop errors are retained. Releasing a native buffer/interface cannot be proven correct against a malfunctioning OS/driver from source alone.

Default console render endpoint is pinned per capture. No explicit render selection, automatic route switching, per-app filtering or self-audio exclusion is implemented. Existing UI says default display; Windows actually uses default render, as documented.

Conservative clock/discontinuity policy may stop on silence/resume or route/sleep behavior. QPC calibration accuracy, drift, latency, power and real device/service failure handling need native evidence.
